name: polypdf-landing
_comment_proxy: Dev server only — CRA ignores `proxy` in production builds, where nginx proxies /api/ to the licence API on 127.0.0.1:3087. Without it, `npm start` cannot exercise /api/commercial-offer or /api/checkout/session at all, which is how the founder deadline drifted twelve days out of sync with the server that enforces it (docs/conversion-audit.md P0-1).

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-discovery-files.js && npm run verify:screenshots && react-scripts build && node scripts/generate-route-metadata.mjs && node scripts/prerender.js && node scripts/verify-prerender.mjs
